title: phone-page row and watch frame tell a stopped cloud run's ending differently
description:
cloudStatusDoc (cloudflare/src/status.ts) maps a cloud run's factory record state "stopped" to lifecycle phase "cancelled", so the phone page's row for a factory-stopped run reads the cancelled class, while the checkout-side Go model for the same run now reads the phase where the epic stands, verdict "stopped", and a needs-you resume (tick jkb's frame). The bare ticfac overview agrees with the phone page (its liveness compensation also renders stopped cloud rows cancelled), so the two ROW classes agree — but the watch frame and the phone page answer one ending with two stories, and hn6's rule 8 says the two renderers of one model cannot disagree. Worth a tick to decide which surface owns the stopped run's story and make the other render it.

ticfac run epic-hn6 created this tick by absorbing the finding 9e28a43c03148c9ee556fbca638abdf91c59228b4d0a0001ba75a7469bf4626d (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-jkb/attempt-12): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A5. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/9e28a43c03148c9ee556fbca638abdf91c59228b4d0a0001ba75a7469bf4626d.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-10-04 22:14 - ticfac run epic-hn6: created by absorbing finding 9e28a43c03148c9ee556fbca638abdf91c59228b4d0a0001ba75a7469bf4626d — placed before the final review, which is blocked-by 5d4. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/9e28a43c03148c9ee556fbca638abdf91c59228b4d0a0001ba75a7469bf4626d.json on epic/hn6, and it says: the classifier put 0.71 of its probability mass on the items rather than on none, at or above the deliberately cheap absorb threshold of 0.35, and named A5: a false positive costs the epic work it did not need, a false negative closes an epic whose goal is unmet in a factory where nobody is watching, and those are not the same cost — the threshold sits on the cheap side
